verdict.rationale: Fireworks' first-party docs say it offers an OpenAI-compatible endpoint and OpenAI-compatible APIs. They also call it a drop-in replacement for OpenAI ('same API') and tell developers to point their client at api.fireworks.ai. Together this covers the core of swapping the base URL and API key in an existing OpenAI client. Missing for 10: an explicit documented OpenAI SDK snippet showing only base_url and api_key changing, a statement of which OpenAI endpoints or parameters are compatible, and independent or hands-on confirmation that an unmodified OpenAI SDK client works.
